svg.text: 6 MW BoS INVERTER & MV SWITCHGEAR SHED - GROUND FLOOR PLAN
60 x 100 kW string inverters (2 racks x 2 tiers x 15), 6.3 MVA 0.8/33 kV TX, 5-panel 33 kV MV lineup
P1 in / P2 TX VCB / P3 out / P4 aux / P5 spare
1. Tiers stacked: each inverter symbol = 2 units
2. DC feeders enter through gland strip at 0.3 m
3. LV AC in floor trenches -> cross trench ->
4. MV: TX HV -> trench -> P2; P1/P3 exit east
5. No PV modules on roof, walls or yard.
Plan view, dimensions in m. Concept layout.
